test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some girls are boys.

No boys are lazy.

**Conclusions:**

1. Some girls are lazy.

II. Some girls are not lazy.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/819cb8c9cf66e45243924e6848d6e1e6deb09e0b54d62742b50f792905ba308a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some girls are lazy → **Does not** follow (As some girls are boys and no boys are lazy. As no direct relation is given between girls and lazy, therefore it is false)

II. Some girls are not lazy → Follow (As some girls are boys and no boys are lazy. As gilrs has some part common with boys which cannot be lazy, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
